name: commentless-monorepo
description: commentless — one convention, one implementation per language.

scripts.ci:python: uv run --directory packages/python --frozen ruff check . && uv run --directory packages/python --frozen ruff format --check . && uv run --directory packages/python --frozen mypy src tests && uv run --directory packages/python --frozen pytest tests && uv run --directory packages/python --frozen commentless . --check --docstrings
scripts.ci: bun run format && bun run ci:js && bun run ci:python
